sheets.title: COVER SHEET / CODE SUMMARY INFORMATION
sheets.reading_notes: Cover sheet for the Bondurant Associates architect-of-record drawing set (job 2302). Contains: vicinity map locating site at 4608 Deep Creek Blvd Portsmouth VA 23702; project title 'Partial Renovation of The Way, The Truth, and The Life Church'; index of drawings (C1.0, A1.1, A1.2); code summary block (Virginia construction codes, city Portsmouth jurisdiction); Description of Proposed Work block (partially legible — describes relocation/renovation of mens restroom, womens restroom, and office; replacement of interior finishes and fixtures); lead design professional Jeffrey H. Neighbors AIA; architectural firm Bondurant Associates / James A. Hall Jr. (license 0401058869). Building permit data block includes construction type, fire district, hazardous materials fields. Per index: sheet set is C1.0 + A1.1 + A1.2 only (3 sheets total for architect's set).

sheets.title: DEMOLITION FLOOR PLAN AND NEW WORK FLOOR PLAN
sheets.reading_notes: Sheet 01 of 02 for Bondurant Associates set. Three plan views at 1/4"=1'-0": (left) New Work Reflected Ceiling Plan, (center) New Work Floor Plan, (right) Demolition Floor Plan. Scope: Womens Restroom (multi-fixture, right side), Mens Restroom (multi-fixture, left side), a Corridor connecting both, and a Future Pastor's Study adjacent. The new floor plan shows new partitions creating two restroom suites; the demolition plan shows removal of existing partitions and fixtures. Fixtures annotated numerically per door/hardware/fixture schedules on A1.2. Wall type markers reference legend. The reflected ceiling plan shows new suspended ceiling system, access panels, and light fixture locations. No area square footage given; plan dimensions legible for individual rooms (e.g., restroom approximate 10'-12' widths visible but not specifically annotated as a total). General notes require fire extinguishers per local code, continuous sealant bead, vinyl base.

sheets.title: SCHEDULES AND DETAILS
sheets.reading_notes: Sheet 02 of 02 for Bondurant Associates set. Contains: Door Schedule (2 doors: D01 interior restroom — 3'x7'x1-3/4", hollow metal frame, wood door; D02 womens restroom — same size, hollow metal); Hardware Schedule (2 hardware sets); Elevation — Toilet Accessories (ADA grab bars, tissue holder, paper towel dispenser, mirror, lavatory, baby changing station); structural/architectural construction details including new-to-existing slab detail, section at new opening, typical new-to-existing slab detail at trenches, partition types (4 types with varying heights relative to slab/deck), deflection track detail. Partitions General Notes visible (metal stud specs, bracing). Legend for partition heights. This sheet documents scope requiring slab saw-cut and patch for new plumbing rough-in — confirms below-slab DWV work.

sheets.title: PLUMBING DEMOLITION PLANS (DOMESTIC WATER AND SANITARY)
sheets.reading_notes: Page 1 of 3 in BFA progress drawing package. BFA project 24-034. Two plan views at 1/4"=1'-0": (left) Domestic Water Plan - Demolition, (right) Sanitary Plan - Demolition. Notes call for: (1) remove fixtures including supports, domestic water supply connections and associated appurtenances completely; (2) remove domestic water piping, supports, and associated appurtenances completely to point indicated; (3) remove sanitary piping completely to point indicated; (4) 40-gallon gas-fired water heater shall remain; (5) domestic water piping to remain to point indicated; (6) sanitary piping to remain. Existing fixture locations shown dashed. Two restroom suites visible (one each side). Water heater identified as gas-fired 40-gallon unit — to remain. This confirms gas service exists at building.

sheets.title: PLUMBING NEW WORK PLANS (DOMESTIC WATER AND SANITARY)
sheets.reading_notes: Page 2 of 3 in BFA progress drawing package. Two plan views at 1/4"=1'-0": (left) Domestic Water Plan - New Work, (right) Sanitary Plan - New Work. Plumbing Fixture Connection Schedule: P-1 Flush Tank Water Closet (HC) floor-mounted (qty 2, CW 1/2"), P-2 Flush Tank Water Closet floor-mounted, P-3 Flush Valve Urinal wall-mounted, P-4 Lavatory counter-mounted (CW/HW 1/2", waste 1-1/2"), P-5 Shower floor (CW/HW 3/4"). Pump Schedule: RCP-1 Recirculating pump — Inline type, 5 GPM, 0.5 HP, 120V, 1-phase — with Note 'X' indicating additional detail. Notes on sheet: (1) provide top-mounted centerset faucet with flow rate of 0.5 GPM; (2) see architectural drawings for mounting heights; (3) provide stops. Sanitary plan shows 4" FCO (floor clean-out), 2" FD (floor drain), VTR (vent through roof), typical 2" vents. New 2" to 4" sanitary piping routed to existing lines. Domestic hot water recirculation loop provided (RCP-1 pump). Below-slab work confirmed (saw-cut per A1.2 details).

sheets.title: MECHANICAL NEW WORK PLAN
sheets.reading_notes: Page 3 of 3 in BFA progress drawing package. Single floor plan view at 1/4"=1'-0": Mechanical Plan - New Work. Two inline exhaust fans (EF-1 and EF-2) shown serving the two restroom suites via ductwork routed at ceiling. Supply grilles (type A: 6x6 neck / 10x10 face) and exhaust grilles (type B: 10x10 neck / 10x10 face). Exhaust Fan Schedule: EF-1 inline, 220 CFM, 0.5 ESP, 1035 RPM, 115V/1PH, 1.42 FLA; EF-2 inline, 200 CFM, 0.47 ESP, 1000 RPM, 115V/1PH, 0.56 FLA. Grille/Register/Diffuser Schedule: Type A grille (6x6 neck, 10x10 face, 0.06 APD) for exhaust; Type B grille (10x10, same). Notes: (1) exhaust fan, refer to spec sheet M-601 for additional information; (2) provide wall-mounted gravity damper; (3) provide manual balancing damper. Remarks: (1) provide with disconnect switch; (2) exhaust fan shall be controlled by occupancy sensor. No supply/heating system shown — limited to exhaust ventilation only. Existing HVAC serving the larger church space presumably handles general conditioning; BFA scope limited to restroom exhaust.

gross_square_footage.notes: No area tabulation present in any drawing. Renovation scope is limited to two restroom suites and adjacent office/pastor's study. Based on plan scale and visible dimensions, renovation area is estimated at under 1,000 SF, but no reliable count is extractable without scaling — not attempted per medium-depth rules.

floor_count.notes: All plans are single-floor. Ceiling heights reference bottom-of-roof-deck and bottom-of-bar-joists (per A1.2 partition legend). No second floor or basement shown. Below-slab plumbing work (saw-cut trenches) confirms slab-on-grade construction.
